anh_en: Sol-III, the third planet from the sun. A world of chaos and change, where old conventions are discarded and disasters run rampant. Human civilization struggles to survive in this new era of destruction and rebirth, facing uncharted challenges with unwavering determination.

The Lament's power causes destructive waves across the land of Solaris. Manifestations like the "Tacet Fields," "Tacet Discord Outbreaks," and the enigmatic "Tacetite" are part of what is collectively known as the "Waveworn Phenomena."

The term "Lament" refers to the ongoing catastrophic events on Solaris-3. Since the onset of the first Lament, the cycle of destruction has persisted relentlessly. The tide of devastation remains ceaseless, with no signs of stopping.

The "Tacet Fields" are thought to be where all Tacet Discords originate. These locations feature a sky of inverted seas and a deep cross-shaped Tacet Mark on the ground. Reverberations fill the air, linking our world to an unknown space through a white Resonance Cord. These areas attract gatherings of Tacet Discords.

Individuals with the ability to resonate with certain objects and manipulate their frequencies are known as "Resonators." These individuals exhibit unique "Resonance Abilities," also known as their "Fortes," through the "Tacet Mark" on their bodies. According to experts, a Resonator's abilities are often influenced by their past experiences and subconscious mind.

Tacet Discords, created by the Waveworn Phenomena, are dangerous entities with ever-changing, amorphous forms. They possess "Tacet Cores" and feed on other frequencies to maintain stability and evolve. These creatures mimic their prey's abilities, shapes, and behaviors, influenced by the types of frequency they consume.

A type of special frequency that can be captured by the Terminal to reproduce Tacet Discords' abilities.\nTacet Discords may leave behind "Reverberations" when they are eliminated, which can then be transformed into "Echoes" through the Terminal's Data Bank, providing a useful advantage in battle.

Wherever there is civilization and history, there will be Sentinels. They serve as mankind's guardians and guides. Their immortal existence has helped humanity through countless troubles, sharing wisdom and prophecies. As we embark on a new journey after enduring the Lament, the Sentinels remain our record keeper and beacon in times of disaster.

Jinzhou, a fortified city on the frontier, stands guard against the looming Tacet Discord crisis. As one of Huanglong's six major regions, it bears the weight of this responsibility as the youngest provincial capital. The Midnight Rangers defend its northern border without hesitation.

Threnodians are formidable creatures born from the Laments, with the power to destroy human spirit and feed off of their collapsed will. If civilizations represent mankind's collective will, the Threnodians embody our fears and struggles. They manifest as destructive Tacet Discord disasters spreading across the planet.

The Waveworn Phenomena is believed to alter matter, information, and energy by converting them into vibrating "frequencies" referred to as "Reverberations." This process has been observed through experimental evidence in the academic community.

A form of pure energy with complete frequencies. The information it carries transcends time and space, enduring in a stable, unchanging state.\nIn their studies of Waveworn Phenomena, scientists discovered "Tacetite"—a substance that can permanently hold Remnant Energy. The Tacetite can be made into potent weapons for Resonators to combat Tacet Discords. Transdimensional spaces where Remnant Energy is abundant are known as the Sonoro Spheres.

The Black Shores, an archipelago enshrouded in mysteries and turmoil, remains sealed away from the world in thick digital fog. It remains uncertain when or who will lift its veil, allowing it to once more shoulder the task of connecting the world.

Beneath the sea's surface, the Black Shores' underground expanse stretches out as a city shrouded in perpetual darkness. Here, guided by their studies of the stars, Solaris' observers and modulators tirelessly search for the path to salvation...

The garden, nestled within the depths of the subterranean galaxy, serves as both the lens to observe its great expanse and the Shorekeeper's dwelling during her confinement by the Tethys System. It is said that the garden existed well before the founding of the Black Shores, functioning as the eye that gazes upon the stars. However, what the eye perceives may remain unknown to the heart. What truths lie behind these supreme concepts?

An ancient, secluded town nestles within the tranquil embrace of Mt. Firmament. Elegant structures, scattered among the crimson leaves and tipped with pure white snow, create a scene of serene beauty. \nFor centuries, the people of Hongzhen revere the Sentinel, who safeguards their town, as their god, praying devotedly for its blessing of lasting prosperity and longevity. Despite the year-round snowfall blanketing Mt. Firmament, the warm springs flowing from the mountains and the vibrant life of the townsfolk make the cold no more a concern.

A sanctuary in the southeastern seas of Jinzhou, sealed away beyond the reach of common folks in thick fogs.\nAccording to ancient records, Mt. Firmament is the ancestral home of Jinzhou's earliest settlers. Sentinel Jué once descended upon this land, using the power of Temporal Mandate to protect it from Tacet Discords. Consequently, the flow of time within Mt. Firmament diverges from that of the outside world. \nIn earlier times, scholars from the Court of Savantae were fortunate enough to uncover the mountain's hidden mysteries, leaving behind research facilities and invaluable records before vanishing without a trace.

The capsule that descended with the Sentinel upon Mt. Firmament now lies concealed in the depths of Loong's Rest, known to the people of Hongzhen as the Mianloong Chamber. \nThe townsfolk believe that Sentinel Jué may hail from a distant star, and that the Mianloong Chamber served as its hibernation capsule. This site marks the end of the pilgrimage and the gateway to Jinzhou's true future.

A future beyond this System lies beyond sight.\nIts fall shall usher forth the world's inevitable ruin.\nFrozen, torn asunder, consumed by flame... So be it, gaze now upon the world's end.

The land is engulfed in flames, while the Necrostar swallows the sky. The black hole at the pinnacle of the Port City of Guixu marks the beginning and the end of destruction. It also holds the key to salvation... Or perhaps, merely a lie.

On the virtual shores, deep within the Tethys System, lies the ultimate destination of the Black Shores in a distant future.\nThe tides of fate bring the lost traveler to this place, where their journey finds their end.\nYet, the guardian of this final destination, like yourself, is but a remnant of that very future.

A nation of independent city-states scattered across a vast archipelago, with no central administrative center. Legends speak of Rinascita's founders, who fled their homeland and sailed to these islands to escape the Lament. \nThe Rinascitan people, with their unique "Common Echoes," have integrated Echoes into every facet of their lives. This is how the nation came to be known as the "Land of Echoes."

Ragunna City, the administrative center of the Ragunna city-state in Rinascita, is a thriving port city by the sea, its districts linked by winding waterways. The Ragunnesi are devout followers of the Sentinel, who believe Common Echoes to be gifts from the Sentinel that carry Their divine will.\nIn addition to their faith, the people of Ragunna are also known for their love of the arts. Magnificent sculptures and paintings grace the city at every turn, and impromptu performances often bring the streets to life.

The Order of the Deep worships Sentinel Imperator and holds de facto rule over Ragunna. According to city tradition, the Order's clergy serve as the Sentinel's earthly emissaries, guiding the people with Their divine word. Under the leadership of the current Primus, Fenrico, a series of laws were enacted to restrict certain themes in artistic expression. These laws have sparked divided opinion among the city's inhabitants.

At the farthest reaches of Whisperwind Haven lies an island where a labyrinth of woods and ruins surrounds a central lake. It is spoken of in knight's tales, said to be the destination of their quests. To this day, the restless spirits of those who sought it wander the ancient paths of the grove.

The sea of clouds lingering in this place is formed by concentrated Remnant Energy. Local legends of Ragunna speak of a serene, mirror-like area at the heart of Nimbus Sanctum, said to purify the darkest of thoughts and transform them into part of the clouds. At times, a haunting melody can be heard echoing from the depths of the sanctum.

Built by the Montelli family, Averardo Vault stands like a heavily guarded fortress on the outskirts of the city. Within its walls lies the family's vast collection of treasures, including precious metals, artworks, and rare Echoes. The vault also provides public services such as secure storage for valuables, appraisals, and acquisition of rare collections.

This peninsula thick with oak trees was once where Rinascita's rulers gathered for secret councils. The Oracles carved into the stone and trees have withstood the passage of time, though their messages are now nearly impossible to distinguish.

The rugged mountains of Thessaleo Fells always seem shrouded in the darkness of night, their gloom as deep as the abyssal sea. Once the domain of the Fisalia family, the oldest lineage in Ragunna, this desolate place remains one few outsiders dare to tread.

The Fool's Troupe travels across all of Rinascita, but their base sits in a vast cavern on Penitent's End. Their creed is freedom, their treasure is laughter, and their gift to every city they visit is a new tale.

This forsaken island, shrouded in dense sea mist, is dominated by steep cliffs with giant ringed structures. Ships caught in the currents often end up stranded on the island's treacherous shores. For those lucky enough to survive the wreck, even greater horrors await...

Averardo Bank utilizes an Echo train system to move clients' collections and staff to and from Averardo Vault.\nOnce the Echo trains reach the underground station of Averardo Vault, the collections within will undergo a second sorting process before being moved to specialized storage facilities.
A facility holding collections of works of art and rare Echoes from across the world, even including artifacts that have survived the Lament and Echoes from ancient times.

Collections housed in this area are often referred to as "vessels of creativity and ingenuity."\nFor artists and inventors laboring under the patronage of a wealthy family, all their creations, tangible or intangible, are considered assets of the patrons.\nThe act of creation becomes a measure of worth, by which these creators' value is defined.
Located within the depths of Averardo Vault, off Echo train network, this tower is known to few. What dark secrets does the place hide?

A group of islands northwest of Ragunna, rich in various marine resources. Falling out of the governance of the Order of the Deep, these islands have preserved the customs from Rinascita's Age of a Thousand Islands era, setting them apart from the rest of Ragunna in lifestyle. However, rumor has it a great mystery lies hidden within this secluded paradise...
Once a theological seminary of Rinascita, it now rests in the boundless expanse of clouds. It once recorded Rinascita's glory and grandeur, along with countless unspeakable secrets.
A seminary faintly visible through a thin veil of clouds. Suspended upside down in the sky, it stands solemn and silent, as though carrying the weight of the Blessed Maiden's life.

The mortal world is a vast and mysterious ocean, wherein all souls are doomed to drown and sink to the depths. Those who refuse to be swallowed must learn to rise, climbing upward until their heads break the surface. Only then shall they glimpse the realm of the divine.\nThis proverb, written by the Order, is preserved within the tower.

Majestic and serene, ancient yet still sacred. This is the coronation platform prepared for the Blessed Maiden, though an aura of control lingers above. When the heavy weight of "divine right" falls upon one's head, it feels as if all choices have already been made.

Once the dwelling of dragons, this place witnessed those ancient, mighty beings soaring through the sky.\nNow, wild vines and flowers steadily consume the garden's former glory while the buried history of dragons slumbers in cursed lairs.

An ancient, mysterious castle perched on the edge of a cliff in the outskirts.\nSurrounded by lush flora reminiscent of deep-sea creatures, its interior houses similarly strange and wondrous treasures. Enticing yet bizarre, it pulls the curious in like a whirlpool, drawing them to step inside.

Beneath the shadowed trench, an empty yet defiant gaze hungrily covets the legacy of the heavens.\nOnce a sacred land, only a faint shadow of Avinoleum's glory remains. Those destined to fall still live, while those meant to survive lie buried, transformed into divine oracles no one hears. Their lips remain sealed, and Their ears are bound by words They never spoke.

The capital city of Septimont, one of Rinascita's city-states. Perched atop Capitoline Hill, it boasts towering stone structures that form the grand "Gryphon's Fortress." After fleeing the threat of the Dark Tide, the bold and battle-loving Septimontians have devoted their lives to chasing the heights of glory. With travelers from distant seas, they gather in this City of Glory built upon the legends of heroes.

The heart of the Great Agon, where Gladiators and Echoes fight side by side. With state-of-the-art facilities, the arena hosts electrifying tournaments of all sizes, broadcast live across Solaris. Here, the air is thick with the crowd's roaring cheers, shattering the silence of the night year-round. It's a place where your blood ignites as you witness the blood, sweat, and tears of Gladiators battling for glory.

An area at the base of Capitoline Hill, near the Borderline Fort. Herds graze in peace throughout lush pastures, and scattered villages nestle among ancient ruins. Yet even in such tranquility, small arenas remain a vital part of life.

A vast plain framed by mountain ranges. Named for the giant boulder clusters left by ancient lava flows, it was here that Septimontian civilization first took root centuries ago. Now, only scattered old villages remain, where wayfaring outlanders often rest before crossing into the Septimont highlands.

A precipitous mountain range that marks the border of Septimont. The craggy peaks form a natural barrier between Septimont and the outside world. During the first outbreak of the Dark Tide, the Border Mountains bore the brunt, leaving them forever scarred by ashen traces and Tidal Blight calcification.

The remains of a coast eroded by the Dark Tide. Temples and sacred statues once erected by Ragunnesi Acolytes now lie in ruin. Their silent halls, devoid of worshippers, are spread across the canyon floor, transformed into haunted dwellings of Tacet Discords.

A dragon of yore once perished in the Border Mountains, attracting numerous dissonant frequencies. Over the years, the area became plagued by Tacet Discords and ferocious creatures. Founding Septimontians saw it as a testing ground for warriors to prove their mettle, leaving behind countless tales of glory. This continued until the first Dark Tide swept through, laying waste to this sanctum of trials and burying its honor beneath Tidal Blight.

In the outlying corner of the Fabricatorium lies an Echo burial ground embedded into deep-sea canyons. Here, heaps of abandoned Brooders cover the floor. Decommissioned Echoes wait in lines to be dismantled and incinerated in the workshops. Their frequencies will be recycled and redirected across the Fabricatorium, feeding the creation of new Echoes.

The core area in the Fabricatorium of the Deep for developing Common Echoes. Endless arrays of Echo Brooders line the space, cradling Echoes awaiting rebirth.\nAs the foundation of the Common Echo system, this site commands heavy investment of security and research resources by the Order.

The energy storage and distribution center of the Fabricatorium.\nThe recycled energy from the Fallen Grave converges here, waiting to be distributed to other areas as needed. All energy is reserved in liquid media. Frequencies born of the tides once again dissolve in water.

A praying ground dedicated to the Acolytes dwelling under the sea, the only sanctuary of the Order's undersea expanse that remains untouched by the Fractsidus.\nThese broken Acolytes are the willing victims of the Order's experiments to free Ragunna's consciousness from the Dark Tide. The countless failed trials shattered their minds, yet still they cling to their fervent memories of faith. Fenrico placed them beneath the waves to live peacefully, away from the prying eyes of the world.

The central tower of the Fabricatorium of the Deep, where the Lost Beyond is created.\nAs the control hub of the entire Fabricatorium, the tower regulates the activities in all other areas within the facility. Deep in the tower keeps the lantern of the first Primus, the first gift bestowed upon the Order by Sentinel Imperator.

A natural pass of solid bedrock, marked by jagged cliffs and towering stone pillars. As the gateway to the Sanguis Plateaus, it has stood witness for generations as Gladiators embarked on their sacred hunt, all under the silent watch of the stone colossus of Atilius, the Hero of Heroes.

A sprawling encampment near Atilius Canyon. This well-equipped base offers rest and recovery to battle-worn Gladiators. Supported by skilled personnel and Echoes, the camp ensures every Gladiator returns to the hunt at their best, ready to face the Dark Tide creatures once more.

The primary hunting grounds for Septimontians for generations. Legend has it that the forest's eternal crimson hue comes from blood spilled in battle. Gladiators drive the Dark Tide's creations into the woods, using traps, tactics, and brute strength to stem the Dark Tide.

A plateau blooming with Asphodels, where spring winds never quite manage to carry the blossoms out to sea. Here, "spirits" linger where they sought glory while alive, and where death cut their dreams short.
A town wiped out by the Dark Tide. All that remains are the Threnodian Leviathan's whispers and thoughts. People call this place Murmurstown in a desperate attempt to bury an agony too great to bear.

The highest peak in the Sanguis Plateaus, named for both its unique summit and the three Heroes of Heroes who once stood there. To Gladiators, it is sacred ground. Legend says that each Hero of Heroes faced their final trial there, and only then would they conquer fate and be cloaked in glory.
A quiet, deserted quarter, where the city's busiest crossroads once bustled with life. Rows of commercial towers and shops line the street, and at the corner stands the famous Shashou Cafe.

Built under the City Hall's initiative, this once-grand football arena has long fallen into neglect. In its prime, however, the annual "Harukaze Cup" drew school teams from across the region and filled the stands with cheering crowds.

Nestled in the city's center, this park was once a beloved retreat, its gardens draped in cascades of wisteria. The fish windsocks floating above the park used to be a popular sight, but now, for some reason, they all seem to be slowly drifting toward a single spot...
A cultural passage beneath the city, famed for its flower trees and the celebrated Seisen Garden. It was once the city's hub for film festivals and photography exhibitions.

Once Honami's business center, this area is now a graveyard of empty skyscrapers, collapsed passages, and abandoned convention centers. The giant cherry blossom trees rising from the ruins have become its new landmark.

This area was once known as "Honami's most beautiful living quarter," where homes and cherry blossoms stood in perfect harmony. Though the houses now lie hollow and lifeless, the cherry blossoms only flourish more vibrantly…

Named after the colossal Exostrider greatsword that holds up the underground dome, its dark waters feel like a gateway to another world. As one of the few regions shielded from Void Storms, it became the foundation for the Spacetrek Collective's Starward Riseway, a lift that scales the greatsword's spine to link this subterranean oasis with the Roya Frostlands.

A sacred homeland of the Roya and the habitat of the Soliskin. Bathed in the radiance of the Reactor Drive, its towering trees reach hungrily toward the light, their deep, interwoven roots returning that energy to the earth.

A vast waterfall often visited by Jetrays. When they leap in unison, their silver wings form a shimmering curtain, hence the name. They travel in flocks for mutual protection, and Roya herders are often seen being carried by their wings, crossing the skies together in serene harmony.

A grand observational array established by Startorch Academy. Unlike the Cassettes, which record humanity, this system was built to record Lahai-Roi. It continuously tracks terrain shifts, ecological cycles, and celestial disturbances wrought by Void Storms and the Threnodian, like a giant eye observing the turning of the ages.

Officially Spacetrek Collective: Startorch Academy, it stands as a borderless scientific community dedicated to the pure pursuit of knowledge. Its name reflects its ethos, "to carry the flame of inquiry and ignite the torch of civilization." Within this vast academic city, knowledge flows freely and cultures meet in harmony.

A terrifying creature born from the Threnodian's influence, found primarily in the hinterland of Lahai-Roi known as the "Mawburrow Desert." Its source of power and its fatal weakness are the Voidmatter Regulators on its head. Wherever it passes, life is extinguished, leaving only the void in its wake.

A lightweight, all-terrain vehicle co-developed by the Department of Exostrider Engineering and the Department of Voidmatters at Startorch Academy. Indispensable for field expeditions, the Academy has created specialized driving courses and multiple training tracks around the campus to cater to the adventurous spirit of its students and faculty.

A colossal lift linking Lahai-Roi to the Roya Frostlands, its structure resembling a spine piercing both heaven and earth. Powered by orbital-acceleration technology, it plummets and ascends through the deep cavern, serving as one of Lahai-Roi's most important transportation hubs.

A warm, humid haven beneath the Roya Frostlands. Following an ancient polar shift, this region became the new Solaris pole, prompting the Roya to migrate below ground. Here, the Spacetrek Collective established Startorch Academy. Today, this borderless academic city has become a cradle for countless rising scholars.

One of the near-orbit space stations humanity built before the Etheric Sea sealed off Solaris. Magnetic disturbances from the Lament sent it crashing down, but it remained largely whole. Its ruins once sheltered the Roya from the cold and served as an exploration outpost.
This sector houses SkyArk's most significant pre-Lament research achievement—a prototype Mass Relay Device powered by Etheric Sea Droplets.

Located within the research base zone, the Icebreak Port is the only regular access point into the Roya Frostlands. Upon arrival, personnel and supplies may be transferred via the Starward Riseway to the underground haven of Lahai-Roi, or routed deeper into the frostlands through the inter-outpost roads.

Once a forest-thick fjordland in the frigid zone, this region was home to the nomadic Roya. Then came Lahai-Roi's first recorded Lament that triggered a geomagnetic pole shift. The land was transformed into the new polar extremity of Solaris, buried beneath endless snow and ice. The violent shift also dragged near-orbit satellites and space stations from the sky. Their wreckage still litters the frostlands to this day.

Formally known as the Spacetrek Collective: Frostlands Polar Research Outpost, this facility is a joint project between the Spacetrek Collective and the Roya people. Built around the Exostrider's greatsword embedded in the ice, it serves as a vital logistics hub.\nHere, researchers work to salvage pre-Lament data from fallen satellites and space stations, run non-invasive diagnostics on the Exostrider to monitor its restoration, and survey the ecosystem to revive the long-frozen flora and fauna of the ancient world.

During the second Lament recorded in Lahai-Roi, the Exostrider, a colossal mech from an unknown civilization, emerged through the Stridergate. It fought a fierce battle against the Threnodian to seal the catastrophe from the other side, a clash that shattered the very bedrock of the frostlands.\nAs the Roya faced annihilation, the Exostrider channeled its remaining power and drove the greatsword deep into the earth to brace the collapsing land. Its Reactor Drive transformed into a subterranean sun, casting warmth into the depths. Its scattered fragments reassembled into the Exoswarm that mimic the local lifeforms, guiding the Roya toward a new homeland. Since then, the Exostrider fell dormant upon the surface, awaiting the day of its awakening.

The true destination of the Soliskin after they return to the Solistrees. They become warm sunlight, flowing down the roots and converging as sparks within the Solvein Heartwood to keep the encroaching Voidmatter at bay.

The first Helios prototype was swallowed by a Voidstorm, ending up here where it drew the Soliskin's attention.\nTwilight marks the hour after sunset. In the Dimmr Plains, this is the Soliskin's final gathering place before they return to the Solistrees.
To stop a past Voidmatter breach, Hiyuki drew upon her Futures' Tithe and channeled a portion of her power to create a seal over the rift.\nThe miko gave everything she had. She always did.
A precipice in the depths of Lahai-Roi touched by Voidmatter. Here, sound itself is consumed.
The shifting, auroral hues are ethereal, quietly concealing the long forgotten secrets of old.

Here, Voidmatter's power swells to its peak. Beyond this point lies the Stridergate, a passage to a universe now beyond your reach.\nBeyond the Stridergate lies the sea of stars you long for, and the darkness that fills you with dread.
The Sonoro Sphere of Sentinel Jué. As dawn and dusk intertwine, and seasons are left disordered, is a place encompassing the beginning and end of all time.
Simulation Training takes place in an artificial Sonoro Sphere dedicated to combat training. Clear the challenges within for various resources.
A unique variant of the Sonoro Sphere that captures a moment of time. Within its depths, you'll discover byproducts of the Waveworn that can enhance both Resonators and weapons.
A unique variant of the Sonoro Sphere that captures a moment of time. Within its depths, you'll discover byproducts of the Waveworn that can enhance both Resonators and weapons.
There are a range of artificial Sonoro Spheres on this land set up to meet various demands.

An artificial Sonoro Sphere-based combat simulation program in development in Huanglong. \nThis facility is repurposed from an abandoned experiment site once owned by the Court of Savantae.
An ember with smoldering flames. A domain of lingering memories.\nIf you step foot in this domain once more, you'll relive the memories of disasters and the "blade of destructions".

Those who are ignorant hinder progress, while the innocent suffer from the challenges imposed upon them. The embers of a fire, sparked by memories of a distant night and fueled by present circumstances, ignite the pain of Scar's past and the rebirth of new ideas, ultimately leading to the downfall of the old world order.
In the ruins, chaotic nightmares lurk in the shadows...
As you step into the train carriage, a journey through a tangled web of dreams unfolds before you.
In the lake, whispers of restless dreams drift gently to your ears...

A unique variant of the Sonoro Sphere that captures a moment of time. Within its depths, you'll discover byproducts of the Waveworn that can enhance both Resonators and weapons.

The music persists, and the crimson curtains are set to rise once more.\nWill you share another dance with her in this long, unfolding drama?
It is said that the fates of the Fisalia heirs are bound to three towering spires, and this is one of them.
It is said that the fates of the Fisalia heirs are bound to three towering spires, and this is one of them.
A two-tiered holy edifice in Ragunna City, devoted to the worship of the Sentinel's statue. It also serves as the seat of the Order of the Deep.
It is said that the fates of the Fisalia heirs are bound to three towering spires, and this is one of them.
The Sonoro Sphere of Phrolova.\nAmid the wild revelry, she beckons you to join in the dance, offering a story in exchange and unveiling the truth behind the curtain.

The vault, controlled by the Montelli family, houses an exquisite collection of rare Echoes and artwork. Surrounded by natural barriers and perched atop a high vantage point, it offers a breathtaking view of Nimbus Sanctum.
A hall set for a banquet, grand enough to dazzle, yet secret enough to conceal.\nAt this very moment, a trade initiated by one Montelli is being undone by another.
Behind the mirror lies a realm where the illusions of the past intertwine with reality, yet the path ahead leads to an completely different destiny.
Realm of Ego: Mirrors in the Mirror
A prison built of power and fear is strong enough to chain the mind—but it cannot silence the song that rises from within people's hearts.

The deepest point of the Averardo Vault. Lower ranking staff might not even be aware of its existence. Legend say an intruder would meet their end at the hands of the Echo guard, descending from a height to deliver their fate.

A desolate field of ruins that sits near the Strand. As fog cloaks the sea, distant whispers emanate from within, enchanting the weary sailors. Little do they notice, they're lured into a howling vortex and a realm of death.

Time and space collapse into chaos here, and all things dissolve into nothingness. When the storm heralds a new world, the crown of thorns will finally settle upon her head.\nThereafter, Divinity descends.

Ancient, enigmatic spirits slumber in the lake's depths. Their eyes once summoned stars, leaving trails of fleeting, radiant light across the night sky. As you glide across the lake, another vast world seems to stir in its reflection, just within reach.

An annual festival in Egla Town to honor those who have passed.\nWhen night falls, the townspeople don masks and dress as ghosts to attend the commemorative event. Legend has it that on the Night of Remembrance, vengeful spirits return to the mortal realm. Who's to say whether the person reveling beside you is human, or something else...

Officially known as "Remnant Cubes," these advanced artificial intelligences were created for the Second Coming of Solaris using Encore's abilities and Tethys's microprocessing support.\nThe Remnant Cubes differ from their originals in subtle to outright obvious ways. The cause of these variations remains unclear. Is it the user acting as the anchor point, Tethys's scanning and data support, or Encore's artistic leeway as the master artisan?

Ciaccona's Sonoro Sphere, created through her perception of melodies and echoes.
Memories and stories carried by the melodies manifest here as still, frozen images.
But through Ciaccona's tuning, these stories and memories come together as notes on a music sheet.
As the notes play, the images begin to move and unfold.
What will become of this twisted tale? What awaits at the end of this path, beyond the heroes' triumph...?
The music persists, and the crimson curtain rises once more.\nIn this endless drama, you have no choice but to accompany her, one dance after the other.
An artificial Sonoro built by Phrolova in the Fabricatorium, a manifestation of her life's dreams and aspirations. It is so vast that it defies conventional measurement.

A shifting realm between life and death, existence and nothingness. It is not a place in the physical sense, but a convergence of infinite possibilities that includes all of Iuno's emotions, memories, and connections. \nHere, her specter wanders, stuck reliving her past… until enough fragments of hers are captured and anchored. Only then can the girl erased by the world reclaim her future.

A cutting-edge weapon testing program launched by the Black Shores to minimize field agent losses. \nTesters are tasked with deploying autonomous combat units within an artificial Sonoro to halt waves of simulated Tacet Discords. The Tethys System evaluates the participants' performance based on how effectively they withhold the assault.

A type of highly difficult test in Tidal Defense Simulator.\nIn Deathtrap Mode, participants must rely on Overwatch Protocols and enhanced logistical support to withstand evolved waves of Tacet Discords.

An ancient marvel built by master artisans, the Ephor's Palace stands solemnly as a silent witness to the shifts of Septimont through the ages. As the administrative center of Septimont, it upholds the city's order and cohesion. Here, Septimont's leaders convene daily with the Ephor to chart the course of the land's future.
Leviathan's avatar rises with the boundless Dark Tide, seeking to "unify" the world in eternal darkness. Stand against the end, and fight for the faintest hope of dawn.
Amidst the bamboo grove verdant, a killing edge lies hidden.
The Lament's lingering power gathers here, replaying the battles of the past.\nThose unfulfilled dreams, unresolved obsessions… They are no myth.

Founded with the core mission to nurture "Synchronists" capable of Augmented Resonance with the Exostrider, Startorch Academy established Rabelle College. Its research is built upon three domains: Exostrider studies, Void Storms, and Reactor Drive energy, giving rise to the Departments of Exostrider Engineering, Voidmatters Science, and Light Energy Sciences. Within the latter, the Division of Ecology Conservation, closely tied to the work of the Exo Genesis Labs, is affectionately nicknamed the "Agronomy Wing."

A live-fire facility for testing tactical weaponry and mechanized constructs, operated by the Division of Tactical Development under the Department of Exostrider Engineering. This site supports full-scale weapon validations and equipment trials, and its grounds are open to all Academy faculty and students.

Bathed in the constant radiance of the Reactor Drive, this plain teems with life. Flora, fauna, and Exoswarm creatures convert light and heat into diverse energy forms, channeling them through intricate ecological cycles. Every being contributes to this self-sustaining web of life.

A vast valley stretching between the Starward Riseway and the Etching Plains. Its name, translated from Royan itself, refers to the jagged square cliffs and stone spires that jut from the valley like the serrated teeth of a giant, forever studded into a scar upon the earth.

An arched region that collapsed many years ago during a subterranean Void Storm eruption. As the land gave way, buried cable grids and mechanical spinal frameworks were laid bare like the sinew and bone of the earth itself.

The Roya elders are organized into the Six—three pairs holding roles such as the Eye, the Binder, and the Shaper. Each pair is entrusted with a core function: observation, archival, and extrapolation. They dwell within the Solisylum, linking their consciousness to the Heliogyre to trace the Reactor Drive's trajectories and forecast Void Storms. To maximize efficiency, only one of the Six remains awake during each cycle to oversee daily affairs. At the close of each season, Shepherds from all settlements gather in Bjartr Woods to deliver their recorded data, which the Six then deliberate upon to chart the future.

Officially Spacetrek Collective: Research Institute, it stands as part of the same borderless research initiative—the Spacetrek Collective—as Startorch Academy. Its mission is to extract and apply advanced technologies. Linked directly to the Starward Riseway, the Institute rests above the greatsword's tip like a guarding Stargram, watching over Lahai-Roi from above.

The sun of Lahai-Roi, the source of its life, the cornerstone of the Royas' sacred duty, and the heart of the Spacetrek Collective's Helios Project. But now, the Exostrider's heart is corrupted by the Threnodian's frequencies, teetering on the brink of collapse. Should it fall, an eternal night will engulf the world.

Vast, boundless space erodes all sense of time, where endlessly repeating moments hold equal weight. The long voyage has yet to reach its end, and the coordinates of the starting point have long since worn away. Infinite possibilities collapse into a single next instant—still a miracle by any name, with no need to return.

The public auditorium in Startorch Academy that serves as the primary venue for large-scale indoor events. It is available for student activities. To host an event here, student societies or fan clubs must submit a proposal and application to the Student Council at least three working days in advance. Upon approval, the event will be officially registered and circulated.
There lies a forever festival that one day shall end.
Here, fading voices and hidden trails are woven into a web, and the rationale of liquid gold is patiently unraveled…

Named after Scott Rabelle, the founder of Resonance Curve Theory and inventor of the Rabelle's Curve, this college—also known as the Synchronist Department—identifies and trains Synchronists through uncompromisingly rigorous, data-driven methods. \nAccess to Rabelle College requires special authorization and is ordinarily closed to students from other departments.

A collective Sonoro that manifested naturally in Lahai-Roi. The exact cause of its formation remains unconfirmed.\nInfluenced by the subconscious minds and residual frequencies of the Resonators at Startorch Academy, it gradually evolved into a mirrored projection of the Academy, becoming a unique phenomenon existing within its grounds.

Ambition, passion, anxiety, sorrow… the Academy's Dark Side absorbs them all without distinction, reflecting the students' rawest and most unguarded thoughts.\nIf left unchanneled, these accumulated negative emotions gather within the domain, eventually spilling into reality.

The Research Institute sealed the Dark Side within riddles, rendering it harmless and turning it into an annual game students eagerly await.\nBy solving these riddles, students confront their doubts directly, releasing and dispelling the negative energy accumulated in the Dark Side.
If the Dark Side is a vortex, then anxiety and sorrow form its very eye.\nInterfered with by the Fractsidus, these negative emotions are now manifesting as aggressive Tacet Discords.
Every student who enters Startorch Academy does so with a sincere heart.\nSuch hearts are treasures that must never be allowed to be tainted.

The rabbit guides those who venture into the Academy's Dark Side, leading them to confront the fears and truths they usually avoid.\nEven after Sigrika's incident, some students and professors continue to face their own dilemmas within the Dark Side.

Outfitted with a range of gaming devices, this club draws inspiration from exposure therapy, helping Synchronists cope with stress by simulating diverse environments.\nWhile the current generation of consoles has its limits, developers compensate with retro charm and a campus-wide online leaderboard.\n"Competition is human nature. It's the same everywhere."
For reasons unknown, the dreams of the Left Behind in Honami have manifested in a corner of Lahai-Roi. Anchored to a Somnoire gate, fantasy and reality overlap here in chaotic disorder.
—Scrawled across a message board in uneven strokes—\n"Do not forget the regret that brought you here."
Here, past and present converge, and time and space unravel into chaos.
It devours everything. Thought, feeling, hope, all reduced to dust and nothingness.\nIt is the Void.
An anchor set over the Stridergate long ago with the Exostrider's arrival. It is essential to opening the gateway.\nOne day, it will be flung open, even if it was meant to keep the danger out.
To prove they can endure the extreme neural load of connecting to the Exostrider, Synchronists must pass a synchronization test.\nAll for the torch of humanity.

Denia. She is denied both a past and future.\nAleph-1 looks upon her. And upon you. What lies before you is absurdity, nihilism, collapse... A puzzle with no solution.\nBut still, she waits for your answer.

The gate opens, and two worlds collide. A lingering nightmare stalks the runners who can't afford to slow down. To plunge into the illusions or to stare down reality? Beyond this gate, she must make a choice.

Warped by inexplicable frequencies, the Somnoire has devolved into a chaotic fever dream. Strange Nightmare TDs now prowl within, seeking to imprison all those who enter this labyrinth of entangled delusions.

The arcade's newest holographic shooter doubles as an immersive training sim for Startorch students, touting a difficulty level reserved for those with the most exceptional skills and biggest guts. But for Rebecca—who has spent her life on the razor's edge—it's just a trip down memory lane.\n"So these goofs are all pulled straight from my head, huh? Then, let 'em choke on my muzzle."

Born of a fevered hallucination, this bustling concrete jungle is shrouded in eternal night, revealing a completely different cityscape. \nA cage forged from sorrow and despair. A graveyard of unfinished dreams and a time long gone.
In the deepest reaches of a dream lie our strongest longings. Here, reality is no longer the tether.\nSo we shall meet here—in that land of a promise.

The students and staff in the Research institute have been evacuated.\nSome staff members stay behind to search for a way to contain the aberrant frequencies. But the source of the crisis remains unknown.
Reacting to Lucilla's mental fluctuations, the sealed Old Research Institute has undergone chaos.\nMemories that can neither be forgotten nor braved come surging back like a tide.
A reading room repurposed into a secret workshop by Synchronist students. \nGenius ideas get their start here, like seedlings cracking through concrete, stretching toward the sky.
A mysterious gateway has appeared, leading to a realm known as Somnoire. Legend has it that it hosts the dreams of all beings in Solaris...

In broad daylight, Daemons once devoured in a great fire whisper through the streets of Ragunna. They wield beloved poetry and music as weapons of their curse. A confrontation, wrapped in the language of art, begins to unfold on the stage of Rinascita.\nRemnants of past sins resurge. From deep beneath the earth, they scheme and plot. When the flames that once ripped through the night return, a silent war will begin.

The brighter the glory, the deeper the shadow. Amid the arena's deafening roar, tales of joy distort and drown in the icy embrace of the deep.\nA champion's path is fraught with peril. When glory itself is burnt to ash by its own flames, none can say who will reach the end victorious.

The Dreamer seals her heart and surrenders to a world of dreams beyond mortal sight. In this hidden realm built upon melancholy melodies, she walks a path of fragile hope and delusions without looking back. But the dreams she longs to realize have long been tangled up in shadow and deceit. Beneath the lofty facade of the Orchestrator, who seems to have everything, is but a wretched, pitiful soul, drowning in her own illusions.\nIn the end, will this dream of blooming and withering be a sweet reverie or a haunting nightmare?

As the hunt begins, horns blare and fearless roars tear through the skies. Beneath the blazing sun, Gladiators gather, blades aflame with valor, swearing to protect Septimont. \nWhen the Dark Tide surges once more, the foretold hero shall rise to conquer the abyss and defy fate.
By Sun's Scourge, By Moon's Revelation
Everything you've done, the world will forever remember.

When the forsaken city crumbles, neon hues twist and devour the past. Between loops of ruin and rebirth, only the unfulfilled longings linger. In this stagnant season, the warm, simple bonds shall become blades to sever the chains.\nLast night's stars still burn. The dawn of tomorrow will arrive.
To the City Set in Amber

Beneath the Startorch, we pledge to carry its flame forward, to stand beside kindred minds, and to push back the frontiers of knowledge. Let every quest for truth be a spark against the long night until it fades. Together, we build a dawn that is ours.
Fine snow drifts gently to the ground, carrying with it the entwined fates of those who walk upon the snow.
For You Who Walk in Snow

People's expectations are like gold, both a blessing and a heavy weight. Even amid the New Solar Celebration's laughter, doubt and emptiness can take root.\nWhen truth stands on the scales, the lurking shadows ask their final, piercing question: Does the pursuit of discovery truly have meaning?

You know all too well that this world has no all-knowing, all-powerful savior.\nThe steps of countless others have become the path beneath your feet. So take one more step forward. What echoes behind you are the voices from beyond the sea of stars itself.
Reverbs From the End of Galaxies

The gate opens, and two worlds collide. A lingering nightmare stalks the runners who can't afford to slow down. To plunge into the illusions or to stare down reality? Beyond this gate, she must make a choice.

The Priestesses have forgotten. Augusta has forgotten... Even though the world has forgotten, you remember Iuno. After all, you see her once again.\nWith her bracelet and the moonlight to guide you, you walk on. You don't know where the path leads, only that you must keep going, until the moonlight finally falls.
Humble and unadorned, this place offers a transitory respite in the looping Lament.
Here, infinite loops pile atop each other, and people's cries become sustenance for the Lament. In the ruins of chaos, only the Tower shows its true face...
Inside Neon Tower, she fell into the cage of her own making.\nPerhaps the girl never truly left her hometown, just as she never escaped her past…
Never in memory has Honami been this quiet…. Chisa, where are you?
The unfamiliar city teeters on the verge of collapse.\nFrom the depths of your memory comes a faint, painful whisper... This is the Lament.

A ruined city, like amber trapped in the Sonoro. Once-bustling streets lie overgrown with wild grass, low roads swallowed by seawater. The Lament repeats endlessly, and time and space are fractured, but this view seems frozen, stopped in a silent eternity.

This soaring communication tower once embodied people's ambition to connect through radio waves. But eventually, it was here that the Lament began. Now, within its disordered heart, it recreates glimpses of familiar pasts, as if luring others to step deeper inside…
The past, the reality, the Lament... Such is the view from atop Neon Tower. See them. Face them. Confront them.\nStep into tomorrow. Nothing can stand in your way.
Bright and radiant is the flame that shines on every corner of Black Alley, leaving no shadow to hide in.
At the sound of thunder, winter snow retreats at the fleeting light.
The one returning from the abyss shall purge this world of filth with hellfire.
When the world falls into chaos, a wind rises and howls, weaving itself into a banner that never falls.
The music has yet to conclude. The crimson curtain is about to rise once more.\nOn this lasting stage, why not give her another dance?
Here, her specter wanders, stuck reliving her past… until enough fragments of hers are captured and anchored. Only then can the girl erased by the world reclaim her future.

When Voidmatter density reaches a critical threshold, the Shimmer descends from the skies and the earth quakes beneath it—the Void Storm follows, Lahai-Roi's most devastating catastrophe. All matter dissolves into nothingness, while infected Exoswarm mutate into massive Voidworms, casting devouring shadows across the land.
The sighs of that person still linger here. O you who are bound in chains, to whom could you ever confide such endless sorrow?

Due to the special nature of this celebration and the Roya Culture Exhibition joining this year's festivities, the Student Council secured the first two floors of Rabelle College with the help of certain talented coordinators. Once tightly restricted classrooms have been transformed into vibrant club showcase spaces.

Every year, the break after final exams marks the season for Startorch Academy's club exhibitions—the perfect outlet for students to burn off their pent-up energy.\nWith the Reactor Core restored and the New Solar Ceremony a success, the Academy's Executive Committee has announced that this year's showcase will be co-hosted with the Roya. Under the theme "New Solar Celebration," the event aims to deepen the bonds between both peoples.
Time to blast off on an interstellar adventure!
Use this time to totally let loose!
Catch the cosmic beat and set sail!

When the Spacetrek Collective dared to build a facility atop a Threnodian, they had planned for the worst.\nWhen Voidmatter broke loose, some left bearing hope. Others stayed, resolve burning in their chests.
A future that was never hers. One she would never reach.\nA dream as fragile as a bubble, bound to pop. Still, isn't there always a sweetness in wanting what you cannot hold?
Within the cage of consciousness, flowing memory data has materialized into shadows of the past. \nAt the end of the path, that one special person is waiting.
The venue commonly used for major academic summits. Access is restricted to faculty and students of Rabelle College.
An area Lucilla remodeled and sealed off using her abilities; a fragment of her "Memory Palace." \nFor the secrets kept within are too cruel for students, and too childish for adults.

When a Resonator's mental strength and Forte are pushed beyond their limits for an extended period, it can lead to a rare state called "Overclocking." While this condition can be managed, there's no permanent cure. In extreme cases, the Tacet Mark can expand uncontrollably, devouring everything around it, with the Overclocked Resonators ultimately becoming a Tacet Discord of the Tacet Field.

Formed from Tacetite and hidden in the Stormy Sea, this archipelago is a sanctuary for the world's most talented individuals. With a mission to combat the destructive Lament, it has fostered extensive partnerships across Solaris-3. While its advanced technologies are shared with the outside world, their origins remain a mystery, even to its members.

Modulation is the process of adjusting frequencies. In Solaris-3, frequencies serve as a crucial tool for uncovering the truth about reality. By altering these frequencies, one can delve into the very core of existence.\nAt the Black Shores, modulating Stellar Matrices is crucial for tracing and analyzing the Lament. Over the course of the Black Shores' history, only one individual has ever been honored with the title of "The Modulator."

Memories converge into frequencies at the fingertip, where sound and form unite—the authority you were born with. Formless echoes coalesce through your power, as you continuously weave a deeper resonance with the world.

The Sentinel of Rinascita, the one who guided the settlers to this promised land to escape from the Lament. In the faith of the Order of the Deep, They are often depicted as a being with the upper body of a horse and the lower body of a fish. Though Imperator rarely reveals Their presence to the world, They often deliver Oracles through the Laureate of Carnevale.

A Waveworn Phenomenon native to Rinascita. It gathers in the sky above and eventually breaks, pouring down in torrents. Wherever the Dark Tide strikes, it spawns Tacet Discords, and the area around its point of origin becomes a new Tacet Field. According to the Order of the Deep, the two significant Dark Tides that occurred in history were stopped by Napoli the Second and the Blessed Maiden Fleurdelys respectively.

Thanks to the Genesis Nexus, Rinascita's Echoes can exist without Reserved Terminals. The people of Ragunna revere Common Echoes as divine gifts from Sentinel Imperator and treat them as friends and trusted allies. Managed by the Order of the Deep, Common Echoes are incorporated into every aspect of daily life, which is the very symbol that has earned Rinascita its name as the "Land of Echoes."

Rinascita's central Resonance Nexus, also known as the Genesis Nexus. According to legend, Imperator revealed the secrets of the Genesis Nexus to the Rinascitans, enabling them to construct other such towering monuments that stand as symbols of the Sentinel's power and sovereignty. Within the reach of the Genesis Nexus, Echoes can endure in physical form without relying on Terminals.

A way station located in Southern Yuan Hills, which is situated in the south of the Land of Xuanfang. All goods, wares, and travelers coming into the territory must submit to inspection by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

A maze-like pagoda located in the Eastern Xuan Peaks, which is situated in the east of the Land of Xuanfang. The pagoda has a complex structure and emits Disorienting Fog all year round. The fog contains frequencies that bewilder Tacet Discords and guide them into their traps.

A war-scarred expanse—one of the many battlefields of the Fortress and Gorges War, ignited over two centuries ago by the Ovathrax. Countless soldiers gave their lives here, all to protect the home they once shared.

A suspended mechanized hold under Mengzhou, which contains the Tacet Discords diverted from the Norfall Barren outbreak.\nIntricately constructed, it splits and traps incoming waves of Tacet Discords through a vast array of mechanisms. Its form can change at will, deploying autopuppets to rotate defense and purge or suppress the Tacet Discords held inside.

A forest east of Shaftpost Yard. Legend says Xuanling birds once nested here, their presence turning every leaf gold throughout the year. However, time has long carried their songs away, leaving only an autumn that never fades. Yet whenever the wind moves through this sea of leaves, one might still hear faint, clear chirping among the branches...

Nestled between Jinzhou and Mengzhou, this territory falls under Mengzhou's jurisdiction. Yet, over the passage of time, Xuanfang has forged a cultural identity entirely its own. The inhabitants there once lived in harmony with a unique species of Remnant creature—the Xuanling birds—revering them as a spiritual totem for generations.

A foyer within the Fogveil Pagoda, lavishly adorned yet retaining an air of refined elegance. Shadows and light dance across the painted screens, solemn and dreamlike. Yet behind the screen at the foyer's end lies a secret unknown to all...

A vast underground facility buried deep within Xuanfang. Jagged cliffs, cascading waterfalls, and traditional pavilions intertwine to form a complex and intricate structure. It serves not only as a containment and processing site for Tacet Discords, but also as a secluded proving ground where Xuanfang Hold's mechanisms and secret arts are tested and deployed.

A factory found within the Western Fang Peaks, located in the west of the Land of Xuanfang. The assembly line known as the Thousandfold Foundry continues to manufacture autopuppets for Xuanfang. Meanwhile, the Myriad Snare in its depths is responsible for disposing of powerful Tacet Discords that exceed the containment capacity of the Censure Courts.

The ultimate convergence point of the Skyworks assembly line. Here, countless components are fused together to forge autopuppets of all kinds. At the far end of this vast mechanical network lies the core of the Myriad Snare—the Snare Platform.
In mist and dawnlight, the truth is revealed.
The deepest part of the Censure Court—the origin of madness and chaos.
A mysterious realm you entered after resonating with the core of the Myriad Snare. An indistinct murmur seems to echo endlessly within.
An old house in Xianling Village, bearing witness to generations of life and inheritance. Now... it appears to have long since been uninhabited.

In an alternate future, the floating isles of Xuanfang Hold become massive Cloud Shuttles, ascending toward the sea of clouds to confront the Lament—only to fall into the fortress's abyssal chasm. There, they are ensnared by thorned vines, becoming nests for anomalous autopuppets.\nLike a breeding ground of anomalies, swarms of rogue autopuppets may erupt at any moment, wreaking havoc upon the buildings that remain on the surface.
A simulated training ground within the Ministry of War in Xuanfang Hold, designed for Xuanfang Wardens' combat drills. Clear the challenges for various resources.

As mechanisms shift, echoes persist without end. The wind carries new tidings, and with them, a long-awaited reunion.\nWhen the blade falls, the skylark sheds its first feather. Guided by the song, the girl steps forward through her dreams, toward a destiny no longer stagnant.
Blade of Past Resounds, Lingering Dream Hymns

A basin located between the Western Fang Peaks and the Eastern Xuan Peaks, where the ruins of Yuan Fortress still remain. Once destroyed by war, the Fortress has long since faded from memory. Yet amid erosion and moss, the outline of its former grandeur can still be discerned.
Once allies, now the greatest foes. This is the final line of defense. Take up your weapon. Only by wagering everything can one find a thread of hope in this direst moment.
The place where it all began. The place where your story unfolded.\nFrom this moment on, a roving life starts.
Gorges of Spirits of Your Memories

These two facilities run day and night to offer support and aid to Xuanfang Hold.

A foyer within the Fogveil Pagoda, lavishly adorned yet retaining an air of refined elegance. Shadows and light dance across the painted screens, solemn and dreamlike. Yet behind the screen at the foyer's end lies a secret unknown to all...

In the Academy, across the frostlands, in the shadows—wherever he is needed.
The scent of mint lingers in the air… A summer that can never be forgotten.

A forest east of Shaftpost Yard. Legend says Xuanling birds once nested here, their presence turning every leaf gold throughout the year. However, time has long carried their songs away, leaving only an autumn that never fades. Yet whenever the wind moves through this sea of leaves, one might still hear faint, clear chirping among the branches...

Denia. She is denied both a past and future.\nAleph-1 looks upon her. And upon you. What lies before you is absurdity, nihilism, collapse... A puzzle with no solution.\nBut still, she waits for your answer.

This area was once known as "Honami's most beautiful living quarter," where homes and cherry blossoms stood in perfect harmony. Though the houses now lie hollow and lifeless, the cherry blossoms only flourish more vibrantly…
In the space between past and future, perhaps, snow once fell in Honami.
